programs.description: Three big cat families have made Botswana's Gomoti River their home and use their skills to outsmart predators and rivals while co-existing in a shared space.
The filmmaker provides a deep dive into the unique wildlife habitat that is thriving in the Danube riverbank forests ecosystem in the heart of Europe.
The filmmaker explores the behaviour, characteristics and survival strategies of venomous vipers that inhabit the Iberian Peninsula.
The filmmaker explores the lives of four tigresses in Central India who are rewriting the rules of how a tiger pack survives and hunts.

Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in "Natural Born Monsters." When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.
The filmmaker sheds light on the fight for supremacy among a leap of leopards in the Sabi Sands Game Reserve of South Africa after their queen of 12 years is no more.
